summary: migration_bridge.py materializes one declared future RED test only; supports W0-W6 templates with TWR identifiers; validates slice in implementation-contract.v1.json; selector must be a planned new file and allowed test change; plan must reside under execution-plans; snapshot_paths must exactly equal the selected test; rejects absolute, traversal, logs, execution-plans, and repository-escaping targets; existing target must exactly match template; otherwise creates parent directories and LF UTF-8 file; CLI requires repository-root, plan-dir, slice-id, snapshot-path, and --materialize-only; output status=materialized with empty authorizes; no Quick Dev slice authority is granted
